findings.title: Variant-level classification and conflict counts
findings.method: Unique Variation IDs, germline VCV classification; explicit denominator for each ratio
findings.limits: Deterministic lowest-ID sample, not random and not a population prevalence estimate.

findings.title: Documented classification differences
findings.method: Current germline SCVs, exact NCBI MedGen condition-set match, independent organization IDs; P/LP and B/LB grouped separately from VUS
findings.limits: Current submission-level differences are not necessarily ClinVar aggregate conflicts; dates, review tiers and noncontributing submissions remain explicit.

findings.title: Review status and documentary completeness
findings.method: Count official review labels and available SCV metadata, without invented reliability score
findings.limits: Declared criteria/review tier do not establish correctness; missing metadata is not evidence of invalidity.

limitations: Research only: no diagnosis, treatment or individual genetic analysis.
Sample is deterministic by lowest Variation ID within the official single-gene query; no representativeness claim.
VCV, RCV and SCV denominators are distinct. Germline classifications only.
Same-condition comparison requires identical NCBI-mapped MedGen condition sets; unresolved mappings are not forced.
P/LP and B/LB likelihood-only differences are separated from cross-band differences.
Contributing and noncontributing SCVs are reported separately; dates do not prove causes of disagreement.
VEP molecular consequence is independent of clinical classification; only exact GRCh38 SNVs qualified.
No artificial confidence/pathogenicity score, causal conclusion, clinical validation or model-weight learning.
